I completed a CELTA qualification in 2010. I come from a journalistic background. I completed studies in the UK in broadcast journalism(BA) and screenwriting(Postgraduate). I have been working full time as an English teacher since 2010, in private schools and with private students. 

I can help you with any aspect of your English learning, whether it is for exam preparation (IELTS), business or pleasure.

 I worked for the university organisation AIESEC, teaching university students, and I was also part of a European Union project working in Polish Gimnazjum (middle schools), where I travelled all across the Polish region of Podlasie teaching various groups of teenagers and giving presentations. I currently have more than 15 private students and I also work freelance for a local private school, where I teach a group of high school students and a group of adults. 

My lessons are tailored to each individual student. I find out what interests my students and then I present them with material relevant to those interests and we talk and complete written and listening exercises. 

Every student is different so methods are adapted to suit each person. For example, I find that for some people, conversation about a specific topic with constant correction and the introduction of useful phrases/vocabulary, is sufficient. 

Other students need more focused and structured lessons that involve a mix of grammar exercises, speaking and listening. 

I am an expert in guiding the conversation in the appropriate direction in order to maximise learning and move students along their path of English learning.

pro_course_detail.description:

Have you developed bad habits from speaking English incorrectly for years?

We will also learn new, student-specific vocabulary that will have you speaking better English in no time.

Curated from years of teaching experience, these fundamental language elements will soon rehabilitate your communication skills to be more accurate and effective. Speak with confidence!

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Speaking Test Preparation
pro_course_detail.description:
The IELTS speaking test is not easy but I can help make it feel easier.

I have helped thousands of students to prepare for the IELTS speaking test, so I know how to assess your answers and also help you improve, allowing you to give the best answers possible in your IELTS test.

It does not matter how good your English currently is, we will find the best way for you to improve as we work towards your test together.

We will go over many practice questions, so you can work on getting your answers as good as they can be. I will offer lots of feedback and advice so that you can improve your answers.

I want to help you achieve the best score that you possibly can!

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Writing Marking & Feedback
pro_course_detail.description:
I will set you 2 IELTS essay questions (tasks 1 & 2), which you will complete for homework before the lesson. I will assess your essays and give you lots of feedback on how your essays could be improved. This feedback will be discussed in the lesson together.

For a 1 hour lesson, we will aim to do 30 minutes of writing feedback and 30 minutes of IELTS speaking test practice as well.

**Please send me your essays at least 24hrs before the lesson to allow me to assess them**

When assessing your writing, I will look at the same criteria that the examiner will use to mark your essay: Task achievement/response, coherence and cohesion, lexical resource and grammatical range and accuracy.

Please complete the 2 essay tasks within 1 hour and be sure not to use any spell checker or dictionary.
